found_at: https://github.com/gokapso/agent-plugins (Kapso's own repo; plugins/kapso/.codex-plugin/plugin.json names it as the plugin's "logo")
notes: No SVG qualifies: kapso.com's header logo is live text, its icons are PNG, and every SVG Kapso publishes (the n8n node's kapso-logo.svg / .dark.svg, the Mintlify docs favicon.svg that the current kapso.svg is) wraps a base64 PNG. This 500x500 PNG is the largest official app mark (kapso.com's apple-touch is 180px, the docs favicon 192px). The current kapso.svg is the docs' inverted version (black K on a white rounded tile) wrapped in an SVG; the site, the plugins and the app use the white K on near-black. The tile is square with sharp corners (as app stores take it); kapso.com's apple-touch has the corners rounded. On the dark theme the near-black tile merges with the surface and the white K carries it; Kapso publishes no lighter version of this tile (only the white-tile docs favicon, which would vanish on light).
